headline: 2,500MW shortage: 35 power plants shut causing widespread load shedding
summary: The shutdown of 35 power plants has led to a significant power deficit, impacting electricity supply across the country.
details: Thirty-five power plants have been shut down, resulting in a massive power deficit of 2,500 megawatts (MW).
This sudden drop in generation capacity has triggered widespread load shedding across various regions.
The power shortage is causing significant disruptions to daily life and industrial activities.
Authorities are working to address the power crisis to stabilize the grid and restore full electricity supply.

headline_marked: Measles outbreak: [[4 die in 24 hours]] as death toll hits 1,144
headline: Measles outbreak: 4 die in 24 hours as death toll hits 1,144
summary: Over 1,300 more people were admitted to hospitals nationwide as the Directorate General of Health Services reports a surge in measles symptoms.
details: Four people died with measles symptoms in Bangladesh over the past 24 hours, with 1,332 more admitted to hospitals across the country.
According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), the total number of deaths related to measles symptoms has now reached 1,144 since records began on March 15.
Of the total fatalities, 104 deaths were confirmed as being caused by measles, while 1,040 died exhibiting symptoms of the disease.
The most recent deaths occurred in the Sylhet, Sunamganj, Khulna, and Dhaka districts within a 24-hour window starting Wednesday morning.
The official count shows that 201,625 patients have sought hospital care for measles symptoms, with 178,927 actually admitted for treatment.
Dhaka Division has recorded the highest number of deaths among those with measles symptoms, totaling 471 fatalities.
Other affected regions include Sylhet with 182 deaths, Rajshahi with 93, Chattogram with 91, Mymensingh with 80, Barishal with 61, Khulna with 46, and Rangpur with 16.

The most recent deaths occurred in the Sylhet, Sunamganj, Khulna, and Dhaka districts within a 24-hour window starting Wednesday morning.

The official count shows that 201,625 patients have sought hospital care for measles symptoms, with 178,927 actually admitted for treatment.

Dhaka Division has recorded the highest number of deaths among those with measles symptoms, totaling 471 fatalities.

Other affected regions include Sylhet with 182 deaths, Rajshahi with 93, Chattogram with 91, Mymensingh with 80, Barishal with 61, Khulna with 46, and Rangpur with 16.
